hints.title: Prefix Range Difference
hints.text: Express the range constraint as pairs with exclusive-or at most high minus pairs with exclusive-or at most low - 1.

hints.title: Binary Bit Tree Structure
hints.text: Insert binary representations of elements into a 0-1 bit tree, maintaining subtree size counts.

hints.title: Branch Counting
hints.text: When the bound bit is 1, elements following the matching bit path strictly yield smaller exclusive-or sums.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs naively requires O(n^2) operations, which times out for n = 20000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A binary bit tree tracks element frequencies per branch, answering query counts in O(B) time per element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate breaks range into f(high) - f(low - 1) and navigates bit branches efficiently.
